mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; sodium valproate may inhibit CYP2D6 metabolism, potentially increasing tolterodine levels, while additive anticholinergic and CNS effects may occur.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, cognitive effects) and consider dose adjustment of tolterodine if adverse effects emerge; therapeutic drug monitoring may be warranted.
